en_title: GTA 6 Causes 17% Spike in Time Off Requests on Game's Release Date
subtitle: 发售日先请个假
opus_summary: 据新报告，《GTA6》发售当天的请假申请量较通常水平增加9%至17%，但无法确认所有人都是为游戏请假。该作将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's release has led to as much as a 17% increase in time-off requests, according to a new report.
paragraphs.cn: 一份新报告称，《GTA6》发售带动请假申请量增加，增幅最高达17%。

paragraphs.en: As reported by Money.com , new data from HR software company BambooHR revealed that there has been a notable spike in time-off requests for November 19. BambooHR revealed that there has been an increase between 9% to 17% on November 19, compared to normal requests for the third Thursday in November. While we aren't sure if every single person is taking that day off to play GTA 6, it stands to reason that this is what the bulk of these requests are for.
paragraphs.cn: 据Money.com报道，人力资源软件公司BambooHR的最新数据显示，申请在11月19日休假的人数明显增加。BambooHR透露，与11月第三个星期四通常的请假申请量相比，11月19日的申请量增加了9%至17%。虽然我们无法确定每个人都是为了玩《GTA6》才在当天请假，但有理由推测，大部分申请者都是为此而来。

paragraphs.en: Economists have estimated a $1 billion loss in productivity in the United States due to GTA 6's release. While we'll just have to wait and see what kind of impact the game has on the world, it is clear that this is a massive event. There's a high level of anticipation for GTA 6, and it is expected to have one of the biggest entertainment launches of all time, if not the biggest.
paragraphs.cn: 经济学家估计，《GTA6》发售将给美国带来10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)的生产力损失。这款游戏究竟会给世界带来怎样的影响，我们还得拭目以待，但显然，这是一件大事。玩家对《GTA6》的期待极高，预计其首发表现即使无法成为娱乐史上最强，也会跻身前列。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has also been spending a ton of money to get the word out with extravagant marketing; it spent $975,000 to install a massive neon pink sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, after all. The developer also covered the city with in-universe ads for brands in the game, along with more traditional banners featuring the game's key art. Fans can even eat at a real life version of Burger Shot , a fast food chain in the GTA universe, if they live in Miami.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar也在斥巨资，以大手笔营销为游戏造势；毕竟，光是在迈阿密热火队主场球馆顶部安装一块巨大的霓虹粉色招牌，就花了97.5万美元(约合人民币650万元)。这家开发商还在全城投放了游戏世界中虚构品牌的广告，以及采用游戏主视觉图的传统横幅广告。住在迈阿密的粉丝甚至可以到《GTA》世界中的快餐连锁品牌Burger Shot的现实版餐厅用餐。

paragraphs.en: There will also be an unprecedented NBA game between the Miami Heat and the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18, which will turn the Heat into the Vice City Heat . They will play with GTA 6-themed jerseys on a never-before-seen Vice City court. It should be quite the spectacle, and serve as an effective final marketing beat for the game.
paragraphs.cn: 11月18日，迈阿密热火队与密尔沃基雄鹿队还将打一场前所未有的NBA比赛，届时热火队将化身「罪恶都市热火队」。热火队球员将身穿《GTA6》主题球衣，在首次亮相的罪恶都市主题球场上比赛。这场比赛应该会相当壮观，也将成为游戏发售前最后一轮营销的有效助力。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A PC port is also rumored for early 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。另有传闻称，PC移植版将于2027年初推出。
